title: Manual verification ledger
disclaimer: Operator attestations only, not independent machine verification. C2 fixtures stay separate. Exact runtime, version, environment, account and commit must match. Missing, expired or revoked receipts never qualify execution. Record and supersede through the administrator API; use non-sensitive aliases only.
loadError: Cannot load ledger. Company administrator access is required.
manualActive: Active manual attestation for this exact recorded context only
notActive: Not an active attestation (or history incomplete)
confirm: Revoke this receipt permanently? History remains auditable.
writeError: Write not confirmed. Retry the same request, or refresh after a revision conflict.
